== Summary ==
A player collects his prize while [[Tamás Papp]] (blue, hand on chest) presents. [[Casey Anis]] is seated in the pale yellow T-shirt (same person and shirt as in [[:File:2024 World Championship prize ceremony 4.jpg]] and #12 in [[:File:2024 World Championship group photo.jpg]]).

* '''Event:''' [[2024 World Championship]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2024-09-21
* '''Camera date:''' 2024-09-21 (Day 1; posted that evening)
* '''Identification:''' [[Tamás Papp]]: face match with his [[:File:Tamas Papp (community card).jpg|community card]], and he was the tournament director, here working the organizers' desk in the same blue T-shirt all day. The prize winner is not named.

== Source ==
Posted in the #2024-worlds-bochum channel of the Players Committee Slack (starwarsccg.slack.com), 2024-09-21. Original file name: 1000006083.jpg (4032×2268); Slack file id F07N9GQFG5C.
* '''Photographer / posted by:''' [[Scott Lingrell]] (Slack: Scott)
